title: The Dalhurst Job
description: Graymoor's warehouse is stacked with silk and spices for market day. I want five crates of it at the safehouse before the sale, and before anyone counts. How you get through the door is yours.

objectives.description: Scout Graymoor's warehouse and its guards
Tell Vex what you found and how you'll get in
Get at least 5 crates out before market day
Get the crates to the Guild safehouse clean

approach_options.name: stealth_infiltration
approach_options.description: Pick locks, avoid guards, take your time
approach_options.risks: Takes longer, but minimal detection risk

approach_options.name: smash_and_grab
approach_options.description: Break in, grab what you can, run
approach_options.risks: Fast but loud, guards will pursue

approach_options.name: social_deception
approach_options.description: Pose as inspectors, walk out with goods
approach_options.risks: If discovered, burns future social approaches

notes: Promotion to Burglar. Rewards Guild armor. Warehouse in Dalhurst docks, client named Graymoor Trading Company (already established in shadowmaster_vex.json dialogue, reused here rather than invented). Threat: Graymoor loses their market-day stock, a real cost to a named trading house. Giver motive: Vex tests planning, not just theft. Consequence: the approach_options block (stealth/smash/social) is decorative - obj_execute_heist is a single collect-5 objective regardless of style, so the choice changes flavor text only. A full fix needs the approach wired as a world_condition or objective_group.
